summary: Frontend-only smoke of the discovery-page vibrant redesign (Topics, Topics detail, GrowAnywhere, RegrowFromScraps, CutFlowers, Bouquet, Guides, Guides detail, Masterclasses, Ask paywall) plus regression of the 8 previously-shipped core pages. All 19 pages render with data-testid=page-hero where expected, no page-hero on bouquet STEP_RESULT, all interactive data-testids present and functional. No console errors or 404s observed.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: review_request referenced bouquet item testids as 'bouquet-flower-*' but implementation uses 'bouquet-candidate-*'. Both parties should align on naming; current implementation is self-consistent and functional.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified pages: /topics (page-hero + topics-grid + clickable tiles navigating to /topics/[id]), /topics/pruning (page-hero + topic-back + topic-rss-*), /grow-anywhere (page-hero), /regrow-from-scraps (page-hero + regrow-pin + regrow-filter-all), /cut-flowers (page-hero + cut-flowers-pin), /bouquet PICK step (page-hero + bouquet-selected-count increments on bouquet-candidate-* clicks; count went 0->2), /bouquet RESULT step (no page-hero, correctly shows arrangement title e.g. 'October Sunshine Tumbler'), /guides (page-hero + guide-card-first-pot), /guides/first-pot (page-hero + back-to-guides), /masterclasses (page-hero + section-foundations), /ask paywall (page-hero + ask-paywall + ask-paywall-cta + ask-paywall-popular-link + ask-paywall-topics-link). Core regression pages all show page-hero: /wellbeing /calendar /plants /garden /recipes /calm /journal /pests. Cookie banner silenced via localStorage pp_consent=rejected. No region modal auto-open on discovery pages (confirmed except region modal did appear during /pests load but did not block anything). AI arrangement generation on /bouquet result step took ~10-15s.
